# Hello World Application

## Requirements

- The application must start successfully.
- When started, the application must display `Hello, World!`.
- Must also output date and time in UTC

claims.text: When started, the application must display `Hello, World!`.
The application must also output the current date and time in UTC.

description: When started, the application displays { "kind":"exact_copy" } and outputs the current date and time in UTC.
missing: The source requires the application to display "Hello, World!" when started, but the candidate description states it displays { "kind":"exact_copy" }. The required display text is missing or incorrectly specified.

sources: When an eligible borrower requests renewal of a loan with no reservation, the service must extend its due date by seven days.

claims.text: When an eligible borrower requests renewal of a loan with no reservation, the service must extend its due date by seven days.

description: On request, the service renews a loan for seven days.
missing: The description omits eligibility and the absence of a reservation as necessary renewal conditions.

sources:
When the reservoir falls below the minimum, the pump must stop until the level recovers.
The controller must display the measured level.
The controller must record each measurement.

claims.text: The controller must display the measured level.
The controller must record each measurement.

missing: The description omits pump shutdown below the minimum and the requirement to remain stopped until recovery.

sources: While the chamber door is open, the fan must remain off; after the door closes, it may restart only when the operator confirms readiness.

claims.text: While the chamber door is open, the fan must remain off; after the door closes, it may restart only when the operator confirms readiness.

description: When the door closes, the fan can restart.
missing: The signal omits operator confirmation as a necessary condition for restarting the fan.

sources:
A parcel may be released only after the recipient identity is verified.
Parcel release also requires payment confirmation.

claims.text: A parcel may be released only after the recipient identity is verified.
Parcel release also requires payment confirmation.

description: A parcel may be released when requested.
missing: The description omits both recipient identity verification and payment confirmation as necessary release conditions.

sources:
After an appointment is cancelled, the service must notify the patient.
The service must display the clinic opening hours.

claims.text: After an appointment is cancelled, the service must notify the patient.
The service must display the clinic opening hours.

description: The service displays the clinic opening hours.
missing: The description omits notifying the patient after appointment cancellation.

sources:
During a power loss, the cabinet must keep the medicine cold for eight hours.
The cabinet must show its temperature.
An alarm must sound if backup cooling fails.
The cabinet must record each temperature measurement.

claims.text: The cabinet must show its temperature.
The cabinet must record each temperature measurement.

description: The cabinet shows and records temperature.
missing: The description omits eight-hour backup cooling and the alarm on backup cooling failure, which are separate obligations in the two sources.

sources: A driver may end a parking session only after payment settles; a failed payment must leave the session active.

claims.text: A driver may end a parking session only after payment settles; a failed payment must leave the session active.

description: A driver ends a parking session by attempting payment.
missing: The description omits successful payment settlement as a condition for ending the session and keeping the session active after failure.
